PROBLEMS AND OBJECTIONS RAISED BY FEDERAL, STATE AND LOCAL AGENCIES, AUTOMOTIVE MANUFACTURERS AND THE PUBLIC
This section summarizes the comments received in response to the Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM) that relate to the Draft Environmental Impact Statement and summarizes the comments received directly in response to the Draft Environmental Impact Statement. The summarized comments and NHTSA's disposition of these comments are grouped according to the basic issues raised by the commenters.
